classification_rationale: No significant indicators were found in the available checks. This means TRUSTLENS could not identify evidence of fraud or compromise; it does NOT prove the site is safe. Always verify the registrable domain directly with the organisation's known contact.

findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security header missing
evidence: The HTTPS page does not send Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS).
Without HSTS a man-in-the-middle can keep visitors on an http:// downgrade. A quality signal only — not evidence of malice.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header missing
evidence: CSP limits what scripts a page may load; its absence is a hardening gap, not an indicator of fraud.

findings.title: No clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors restricts embedding this page in frames.
Relevant mainly for login pages; informational here.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff missing
evidence: The server does not forbid MIME-sniffing; a hardening detail only.

threat_intel.note: Absence of intel hits is not proof of safety — many providers require an API key and are unavailable in this build by default.

ct_history.note: CT logs are public and read-only; data may lag minutes to hours.
